extracted.intended_audience: general public; public radio listeners; potential donors, partners, and journalists
extracted.subtask_description: An 'About Us' page describing a nonprofit investigative newsroom's mission, reach, format, independence, and ways to engage or support the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission / Editorial focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Reveal empowers the public through groundbreaking storytelling that sparks action, improves lives, and protects our democracy. Our mission is to hold the powerful accountable by reporting about everything from racial and social injustices to threats to public safety and democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This functions as the newsroom's guiding standard for topic selection and editorial priorities: prioritize investigative stories that expose power, address racial and social injustice, and cover threats to public safety and democratic institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence and accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: We are an independent newsroom (meaning we don’t have any corporate owners), and are accountable only to you, our listeners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial independence from corporate ownership is presented as a core value and source of accountability; this implies funding, governance, and editorial decisions should minimize corporate influence and prioritize listener/public interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listener-supported funding model and engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Reveal is a nonprofit, independent, investigative radio show and podcast, which launched in 2013 and is listener-supported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames donations, advertising partnerships, and newsletter subscriptions as primary engagement and support actions (references to donating, advertising, subscribing). Emphasis on listener support signals expectations about funding transparency and audience relationship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reach and audience scale as credibility metric
rubrics_metrics.description: It is heard by more than 1 million people each week across more than 500 public radio stations in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience size and distribution across stations are presented as measures of impact and credibility; this can be used to communicate influence to funders, partners, and republishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition and awards as quality signal
rubrics_metrics.description: Reveal was a Pulitzer Prize finalist in 2025, 2020, 2019, and 2018.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listing recent major award recognition establishes journalistic quality and lends authority to the newsroom's reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-platform production and affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: It is produced by the Center for Investigative Reporting, which also produces the investigative magazine Mother Jones, and the podcast More To The Story. Reveal is an investigative radio show and podcast.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies production responsibilities and related properties, indicating standards for cross-platform investigative storytelling and institutional affiliation expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distributed staffing and geographic base
rubrics_metrics.description: We are based in San Francisco, and our staff is spread across the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals a distributed newsroom model; suggests expectations for remote collaboration, national reporting reach, and regional sourcing.
